subject: Self-signup: On-prem pilot — scheduling & stakeholder alignment
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.ai>
To: Emma Jones <emma.jones@medsecure.com>
Date: Sat, 5 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Self-signup: On-prem pilot — scheduling & stakeholder alignment

Hi Emma,

Thanks for signing up for a Private/On-prem pilot with Redwood Inference — really appreciate the interest. I’m Soojin on the SDR team; I’ll help get a short kickoff scheduled and make sure the right engineers and security folks are looped in.

Quick context: our Private deployment supports VPC and fully on-prem installs for regulated workloads; the initial demo is typically a 30–45 minute technical walkthrough + discussion of network/controls and next steps for a pilot SOW.

Proposed 30–45 minute slots (all PT):
- Tue Jun 8, 11:00–11:45 PT
- Thu Jun 10, 12:00–12:45 PT
- Fri Jun 11, 14:00–14:45 PT

Could you confirm which of these works (or suggest two alternatives)? Also please let me know who from your side needs to attend (security, infra, procurement), and whether this will be a fully air-gapped on-prem environment or VPC + restricted egress — that will change the pre-demo checklist we share.

I’ve attached a short preflight checklist that lists the common artifacts we ask for ahead of the technical walk (network diagram, firewall rules, SOC2/AICPA report, preferred contact for network ops). If you can share the network diagram and a point of contact for security, I’ll loop in our Solutions Engineer ahead of the meeting.

Attachments: preflight-checklist.pdf (stub)

Thanks — happy to be flexible on times.

Best,
Soojin Lee
Sales Development Rep | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Self-signup: On-prem pilot — scheduling & stakeholder alignment

Hi Soojin — thanks for the quick follow up.

We’re excited to move forward. A couple notes from our side:
- Attendees: myself (Product Owner), Rajiv Patel (Security Lead), and a procurement observer.
- Availability: afternoons PST work best for Rajiv — Thu Jun 10 at 12:00 PT looks good for us.
- Environment: will be a VPC-hosted deployment with strict egress restrictions (no outbound to unknown endpoints). We will need to review the SOC2 report and your network requirements before the technical walk.

Rajiv and I will need your Solutions Engineer and a technical PM on the call. Can you include Vivek Kulkarni (Solutions Eng) and Connor O'Brien (Technical PM) on the invite? I’ve attached our internal network diagram for the domain and a short note from procurement on SOW expectations.

Links: SOC2 report (we prefer to get the latest PDF over a secure link)
Attachments: medsecure-network-diagram.pdf (we sent this internally; will provide on request)

Emma Jones
Product Owner — AI Integrations | MedSecure

Thanks, Emma — Vivek from Solutions Engineering here. Glad to meet the team. Thu Jun 10 at 12:00 PT works for me. I’ll run the tech walkthrough and cover: deployment topology, network/firewall rules we need, data handling, and the minimal artifact set to stand up a short pilot.

Quick asks before the call to make the session productive:
- Can you share the network diagram and a list of allowed outbound destinations (or the firewall ACLs)? A sanitized PDF or the Excel export is fine.
- If you have a SOC2 type II PDF, please send via a secure link (or let me know if procurement requires an NDA first).
- Any special compliance controls (HSM/KMS, on-prem HSM, air-gapped key management) we should know about?

I’ve attached a blank network-requirements.xlsx template we commonly use — you can fill the sections that apply. I’ll also add Connor for scheduling and the pilot SOW coordination.

Attachments: network-requirements.xlsx (stub)
